source.note: ClientHello, HTTP/2 frames and header sets are those captured for safari-18.4-macos; wreq-util declares safari 26.1 to use the same TLS and HTTP/2 configuration (safari26_1: tls_options!('2', 'CIPHER_LIST_2', 'SIGALGS_LIST_2'), http2_options!(6)). The User-Agent is wreq-util's; accept-language is wreq-util's. Nothing was seen on the wire for this version here. wreq-util declares Safari 26.1 to 26.4 equal to 18.5 — without the X25519MLKEM768 key share that the captured 26.0 and 26.0.1 carry; taken as claimed.
